en: Black‑and‑white image of a long neoclassical colonnade with rows of Corinthian columns and a coffered ceiling. Well‑dressed men and women in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century fashion stroll or stand along the walkway. At the far end are large arched openings. Benches line the wall on the right. The architecture suggests a prestigious spa or public colonnade, and there appears to be faint handwritten text along the bottom edge.
